title: Native While Control Transfer
objective: Support generic native integer while-loop break and continue with nested-loop targeting and fail-closed lexical resource lifetimes

handoff.summary: IR39 adds source-provenanced loop.break and loop.continue for the nearest enclosing while loop. Lowering tracks lexical owner depth and rejects transfers that would bypass vector/matrix/arena cleanup or target a range loop. GMP, fmpz, tagged, machine-word and generated JavaScript emit the same direct transfer. Fourteen focused tests cover nested while/range control, promoted exact counters, CPython/dynamic/native agreement, explicit rejected scopes, one unchanged root arena, and generated GMP/fmpz ASan/UBSan failure, exhaustion, reuse and publication preservation. Eighteen existing range, matrix, arena and nested-arena-guard tests also pass. Architecture, merge inventories and strict Python checks pass.
risks: Range-loop break/continue and transfers exiting a lexical exact-resource scope deliberately remain unsupported; implementing their advance and cleanup semantics is outside this while-only slice.

The full build, broad changed-check suites, production-pack refresh and Windows/Wasm execution remain integration qualifications. This draft lane reused the source-matched prepared frontend/parser and a read-only FLINT prefix; it does not claim a freshly rebuilt production pack.

Root owns test/number-field-cubic-fmpz-closure.cjs concurrently and must update its IR-version assertion from38 to39 when integrating. Other existing IR-version assertions are updated mechanically here.

PR131 changes different resource-item regions of integer-ir.cjs and ir.cjs. The logical-prefix Arb lane changes only FMPZ_FFI_DECLARATIONS in exact-analysis.cjs; coordinate the same-file cherry-picks.
next_steps: Integrate into the staged certification branch and recompile the actual borrowed cursor under one root arena.
Run the complete source-matched production build, compiler/native/platform qualification and staged mathematical replay before promotion.
